podcast.body: This album is noted as potentially being the last-ever pre-recorded major label 8-track release. It was put out in 1987, marking the very end of the format's commercial availability from major labels. "As far as anyone could tell, the last ever pre-recorded major label 8-track release was Fleetwood Max Greatest Tits, which was put out in 1987."
